To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) a joint representation of product content information is better suited to product recommendation than a representation that only includes text or image information, and (b) a joint representation that also includes product co-occurrence information is better suited than one that only includes content information.
Content2Vec is a novel deep architecture that merges text and images and that Content2Vec+ is a novel hybrid deep architec- ture that merges text, images and collaborative information.
• Content2Vec outperforms state of the art approaches on the task of retrieval based product recommendations in the case of cold start and cross-category recommendation scenarios.
In summary, our research is concerned with

two main ques- tions: (1) how do we generate product embeddings that are optimized for the task? (2) How do we combine product content and collaborative information to generate better product embeddings?

the following questions: (a) Can we learn a joint representation of text and image for product embedding that outperforms state-of-the-art approaches? (b) Can we merge collaborative information with the joint representation of text-image to further improve performance?
the following questions: (1) What is the best way to merge product text and image infor- mations for the purpose of product recommendation?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Content2Vec is a powerful architecture that can be easily extended with collaborative information and is a strong contender for product recommender systems.

Content2vec+ outperforms all baselines in the cold-start setup and in the cross-category setup, and it is competitive with the baselines in the normal setup, while it is also the only approach that can be applied in all three setups.
Content2Vec is the most effective approach for product recommendations in all the setups we have evaluated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Content2Vec is the first deep architecture that is able to learn a joint representation of product images and text and is optimized for the recommendation task.
we show that a joint representation of product images and text can be used to generate a unified product representation that can be used for product recommenda- tion.
Content2vec+ achieves state-of-the-art performance on a large-scale product recommender system in terms of both accuracy and efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the joint representation can outperform a purely text-based or purely image-based approach.

by using joint representation for text and images of products we can significantly improve the performance of the recommender system and that this performance gain is even higher in hard recommendation setups.
a unified representation of product content can outperform a collaborative approach and that a hybrid approach that uses collaborative information can further improve performance.
